race.comment: BRUCE I AM (12) progressive gelding heading in the right direction third up. Struck a bit of trouble at the start and rounded them up with ease from back in the field over 1000m at Warwick Farm in BM72 class. Deserves his chance today and can keep the winning momentum going with the 52.5kg. MAYBE MOET (9) resumed after the two average trials for a determined win over 1100m at Rosehill with the 61kg. Goes equally as well second up and stays in the calculations in this harder race. HAY STREET (8) resumes after making good progress last time in. Struggled on the heavy (9) surface when ninth over 1200m at Rosehill last May. Sure to be competitive with the two solid trials under his belt. Each way contender. COMPENSATION (4) fast gelding resuming from a lengthy break. Made it three straight wins when he led throughout over 1000m at Gosford in BM78 grade last May. Primed with the two solid trials and the claim helps.
